item.title: Informational: New Regional Edge Site — Seoul, South Korea (sel1-kr) [monitoring]
item.description:
Dear Valued Customers,
F5 Distributed Cloud Expands Global Footprint into Seoul, South Korea.
We are pleased to announce the launch of a new Regional Edge (RE) cluster in Seoul, South Korea (sel1-kr), further expanding the F5 Distributed Cloud global network. This new point of presence strengthens our coverage in East Asia.
The Seoul, South Korea RE site delivers:
1. Reduced latency for customers and end users in Seoul, South Korea. 2. Improved application performance through localized traffic processing closer to end users. 3. Full feature parity with all existing RE sites.
Go-Live Schedule: 8 September 2026 at 08:00 UTC

item.title: F5 Bot Defense - Service Degradation - F5 Bot Defense Cloud Provider Issue Affecting Origins - INC-20260724-487 [resolved]
item.description:
Between 2026-07-24 10:55 UTC and 11:15 UTC, a service degradation was observed due to an External Cloud Provider issue. This possibly affected communication between F5 services and customer origins, resulting in increased 5xx errors and higher origin latency.
The issue was confirmed to be related to the Cloud Provider and not F5 Distributed Cloud infrastructure. The issue has been fully resolved, and services are operating normally.
If you continue to experience any issues, please reach out to our support team through your established channels.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.

item.title: F5 Distributed Cloud - Service Interruption - Intermittent Latency spikes and timeouts reported in India region- INC-20260626-479 [postmortem]
item.description:
## **Root Cause Statement**
The incident was caused by a **fiber cut on a major regional ISP’s network \(Airtel\) between Indonesia and India.** This disruption led to **widespread congestion throughout the region, and across multiple networks with dependencies on Airtel. F5’s network and infrastructure remained fully operational throughout the event and did not experience any outage or service degradation.**
As a result of the fiber cut, **some Internet traffic to/from India and nearby regions was degraded, leading to increased latency, intermittent timeouts/packet loss, and slowness.**
